meta.credit: The Resolution Library was built by Wyatt Ash-Milby at ATNI
meta.rule: auto class only: ledger rows of class auto or keep are applied; review rows are proposals shown in their own layer

excluded.reason: second 2025-35 on Master row 65, not listed (D-080 item 3)

limits: Outcome and TO NCAI are recorded only in some eras; blank is 'not recorded', never No.
Preparers are not recorded for 2000-2004, the 2005 Winter, 2012 Annual and 2019 Mid Year conventions, or most 2026 rows; the PDFs do not print a preparer.
Committees use the applied key only; proposed aliases are a separate layer until the owner answers Q01-Q05.
The workbook ends at 2019-39 and 2026-33; the site starts at 2007.
Number gaps are missing numbers, not missing resolutions.
Executive Board actions are a fourth session kind; 2014-66 and 2014-67 may be a special meeting (Q12).
Wyatt's own analysis tabs are witnesses, not sources; the page recounts from the library tables.
Titles are the workbook's; 24 are blank.
The committee tabs are copies of Master and are never counted.

fields.with_committee_proposed_only: no applied key, one or more proposed
fields.with_person_applied: at least one applied person key
fields.with_site: applied crosswalk link to the site database

year_by_committee.note: one committee per resolution; a resolution with no applied committee is in 'none'

year_by_committee_proposed.note: links the ledger proposes and the owner has not accepted; a cell naming two committees counts once for each, so the sum can exceed the number of resolutions; no resolution here is also in the applied layer

person_by_committee.note: rows follow 'preparers' order; each cell counts resolutions the person is named on under the applied committee; 'no_applied_committee' counts the rest

readoptions.note: one normalised title under two numbers; numbers and years only, the title exactly as the workbook writes it
